title: Prepare the destination container before moving items
description: Use when placing objects into a closed container such as a drawer or cabinet.
content: Before moving an item into a closed container, navigate to the container and open it first; an open container accepts items directly, while a closed one may block the move action.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two keychain in drawer.

title: Complete multi-step object relocation by moving the heated object to the destination
description: Use this after successfully heating an object and when the task requires placing it at a specific location.
content: After heating the target object, navigate to the destination surface and use the move action to place the object there. Verify the destination is empty or otherwise ready before moving the object.

source.task_query: Your task is to: heat some plate and put it in sidetable.

title: Handle inventory capacity limits when transporting multiple items
description: Use this when you need to move multiple objects to a destination but cannot carry them all at once.
content: If you are already carrying an item and cannot pick up another, place the carried item back down temporarily to free your hands. Then pick up the second item, deliver it, and return for the first item to complete the task.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.

title: Use "look" to reorient when actions fail
description: Use this when you are unsure why an action is not working or need to verify your current state.
content: When an action fails unexpectedly, use the "look" command to confirm what you are facing and what is nearby. This can reveal that you are not positioned correctly or that the target object is not interactable in the expected way.

source.task_query: You arrive at desk 1. On the desk 1, you see a book 2, a cellphone 1, a creditcard 3, a desklamp 1, a pen 3, a pencil 3, and a pencil 2.

title: Clean objects at a sink before placing them when the task requires a clean item
description: Use when the task specifies that an object must be clean before being placed or delivered.
content: If the task requires a clean object, first take the object and go to a sink or other cleaning station, then use the clean action with that station. Only after the cleaning action is completed should the object be moved to the final destination.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a clean soapbar in shelf.

title: Locate target objects by searching nearby containers and surfaces
description: Use when the required objects are not immediately visible at the destination or starting location.
content: When a task requires placing specific objects, first inspect the destination and its containers, then search other nearby locations such as shelves to find the needed items.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two alarmclock in desk.

title: Retry failed actions before abandoning them
description: Use when an action like taking an object or opening a container fails with "Nothing happens" or a blocked message.
content: If a take or open action fails, retry the same action multiple times before giving up, as transient failures can occur. For example, a drawer handle may stick on the first attempt but open on the second, and a take action may succeed after several retries.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Verify object presence before attempting repeated pickups
description: Use this when a take action fails repeatedly despite the object appearing in the environment description.
content: If repeated take attempts fail, check your inventory to see if you are already holding an item that prevents the pickup. Freeing inventory space by moving the held item elsewhere can resolve the failed pickup.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.

title: Verify destination contents after each placement
description: Use when moving multiple objects to confirm progress and avoid losing track of completed placements.
content: After placing an object at the destination, check the destination's visible contents to confirm the object is present before retrieving the next one.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two alarmclock in desk.

title: Clean food items at a sinkbasin before storing them
description: Use this when the task requires cleaning a food item before placing it in a destination.
content: Carry the item to a sinkbasin and use the clean action with the sinkbasin to complete the cleaning step. The admissible commands will confirm when the cleaning action is available.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some egg and put it in fridge.

title: Open closed cabinets before placing items inside
description: Use when the destination cabinet is closed and you need to put an item into it.
content: Before moving an item into a cabinet, check if the cabinet is closed and open it if necessary. Once the cabinet is open, use the move action to place the item inside.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some soapbar and put it in cabinet.

title: Move an object to a destination only after arriving at that destination
description: Use when an object needs to be placed at a specific location and the move action fails from a distance.
content: If a move action to a target location results in "Nothing happens," first navigate to that target location, then perform the move action again. Being physically present at the destination is required for successfully placing the object there.
